answer: The kernel edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 124 clones produces a signature the knoll analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the oasis settlement applies the void retroactively.
